reviewer_role: Diagnostic specification author; evidence interpretation review, not independent scientific-design review.
architectural_question: Whether the fixed jointly trained QK-only backbone provides evidence to remove or otherwise constrain Q/K local residuals in a subsequent fresh architecture.
decision: No immediate Q/K removal, DC constraint, multi-range filter or history gate is justified. Choose bounded saved-row error decomposition before any next training contract.
observations: Whole MAE worsens off in all3 seeds, both splits and both weighting schemes (12 cohorts).
No frozen condition has off improving both MAE and SE in all6 seed/split cohorts under either weighting scheme; descriptive observation, not a newly introduced acceptance gate.
Validation mean RMSE improves, but seed42 worsens; seed62 dominates the mean improvement. Validation mean MAE worsens, with seed62 accounting for95.3995% of summed3seed AE increase; Train82.8776%.
Off mean signed prediction shift is negative for42/52 but positive for62 on both splits, so a uniform output-level direction is not supported.
Mean tail RMSE/MAE and whole/tail TimeNLL worsen off on both splits, despite seed exceptions recorded explicitly.
not_established: Q/K is universally harmful or beneficial.
Which of Q or K, DC component, angular geometry, magnitude, softmax allocation or memory competition drives the output change.
Performance of a separately retrained branch-free architecture.
Train-derived observed-history rule giving stable MAE and RMSE improvement.
Independent generalization, causal explanation of prior rank reversal or statistical significance.

minimal_next_diagnostic.inputs: Only this completed diagnostic samebundle on/off Train/Validation saved rows. Exact same per-seed target/truth/history join; no CNN or older candidate rows.
partitions: Sign of on error, sign of delta, and whether error crosses zero; exact zero category retained, no learned magnitude threshold.
Retain original whole/tail q>200 and existing Train-fixed quantity bins2/30/60/200 only as outcome descriptions.
Reuse all15 frozen observed-history conditions and both existing weighting schemes; no new history cut or score-based bin selection.
outputs: Every seed/split: count, entity support, prediction-shift sum, signed error sum, delta AE/SE and the two SE terms.
Report both-benefit, both-harm, SE-benefit/AE-harm and AE-benefit/SE-harm target sets using fixed zero boundaries.
Determine whether seed62 RMSE gain and MAE harm arise on the same targets or different populations; compare42/52 without averaging away exceptions.
Exact additive closure against saved on/off whole totals; weighted conditions with differing support are never summed.
prohibitions: No interpolation or scale sweep between on/off predictions.
No retrospective checkpoint/seed or target subset selection.
No oracle error-sign condition promoted into a deployable history gate.
No new inference, Q-only/K-only extension, Test read or automatic learning.
minimal_next_diagnostic.decision_after: If a reproducible pre-observation condition separates benefit from harm across seeds/splits without weighting reversal, review that bounded hypothesis against previous methods and specify what internal mechanism would distinguish it. If only outcome/error-sign partitions separate effects or signs remain inconsistent, retain uncertainty; no new structure is selected from this analysis alone.

duplicate_scope.AdaptiveHistory: Already examined history-dependent local tap handling; another generic history gate is not a distinct evidence-driven mechanism.
duplicate_scope.MultiLagDetail: Already has multi-lag history detail; no lag dependence is identified by this simultaneous on/off probe.
duplicate_scope.LevelHistoryQKV: Already includes level/history differences and Q/K control; zero-DC/level-preserving principle is not novel and current output rows do not isolate DC.
duplicate_scope.limit: Bounded previous source/contract audit, not an exhaustive all-history or external novelty search.

remaining_missing_evidence: A mechanism-specific link between a pre-observation feature and stable error improvement, plus distinction from known Adaptive/MultiLag/LevelHistory mechanisms. Saved outcome rows can narrow which targets move but cannot establish Q/K DC, angle, norm or memory allocation mechanisms.
